description: Good defaults derived from the probe layout by EphysPipelineConfig.ks4ProbeDefaults. 16 sites on 1 shank: rows 20 um apart, nearest contact 20 um.

reasons.nblocks: 16 sites, at most 64: drift estimates are unreliable, so no drift correction
reasons.dmin: median spacing of the contact rows within a shank
reasons.dminx: every shank is a single column, where dminx has no effect: default
reasons.nearest_chans: default, no more than the number of sites
reasons.nearest_templates: 16 sites, at most 64: capped at the number of sites for numerical stability
reasons.min_template_size: nearest contacts 20 um apart: the default covers them
reasons.x_centers: a single shank under 300 um wide: one center
